ownerReview.review: KJV remaining New Testament complete-context review

edits.replacement: which accords with godliness
edits.reason: After means according to here, not later in time; no change to the faith of the elect.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.replacement: the things that are lacking
edits.reason: Wanting means still lacking, not desires possessed by things; elders/cities retained.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.expected: having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly
edits.replacement: having faithful children who are not accused of wild living and are not rebellious
edits.reason: Keep the prior wild living and rebellious clarifications, explicitly linking both predicates to the children. Faithful retains the base’s scope rather than settling its interpretive range by counting versions.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.expected: no striker, not given to filthy lucre
edits.replacement: not violent, not given to dishonest gain
edits.reason: Violence and dishonest profit, not sporting position or dirty currency; same contextual sense as 1 Timothy.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.replacement: refute those who contradict
edits.reason: Gainsayers contradict the teaching; convince here includes exposing/refuting error, not winning financial gain.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.replacement: disrupt whole households
edits.reason: House refers to the family/community within, not destruction of buildings; no invented physical violence.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.replacement: dishonest gain’s sake
edits.reason: Completes profit sense from 1:7; preserves their stated motivation.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.reason: Exact modern wording preserves the full verse meaning and grammar.
edits.replacement: always
lazy gluttons
edits.reason: Slow bellies is a metonym for gluttonous idleness, not slow digestion. Preserve evil beasts and the quoted speaker, without adding a modern ethnic judgment.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.expected: their mind and conscience is defiled
edits.replacement: their mind and conscience are defiled
edits.reason: Compound subject with two nouns requires plural agreement in current English; both inward faculties preserved.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.replacement: unfit for any good work
edits.reason: Reprobate here evaluates fitness for good work, not adding an eternal predestination claim; any avoids the scope ambiguity of not fit for every work. Matches the preceding contradiction between claims and deeds.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.replacement: which befit sound doctrine
edits.reason: Become means be appropriate to, not transform into a doctrine.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.expected: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.
edits.replacement: That the aged men be sober, dignified, temperate, sound in faith, in love, in patience.
edits.reason: Grave is dignified, not seriously ill or a burial place. Retains prior love and distinguishes older men by context.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.expected: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,
edits.replacement: In all things showing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine showing integrity, seriousness, sincerity,
edits.reason: Current terms for integrity and dignified seriousness, not physical gravity. Keeps sincerity present in this base though some controls omit it.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.replacement: not talking back
edits.reason: A disrespectful rebuttal, not a ban on answering a second question; keeps the historical master/servant relationship without a modern endorsement.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.expected: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.
edits.replacement: Not stealing, but showing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.
edits.reason: Purloin means steal, here from the master; preserves fidelity and earlier showing.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base
Complete-verse KJV, NKJV, NIV, ESV and NRSVUE control

edits.expected: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
edits.reason: The complete verse preserves earlier approved edits and the newly reviewed contextual clarifications.
edits.replacement: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a people for his own possession, zealous of good works.
rulers and authorities
edits.reason: Civil authorities by the paired obey magistrates, not automatic import of spiritual beings from Ephesians.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.expected: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
edits.reason: The complete verse preserves earlier approved edits and the newly reviewed contextual clarifications.
edits.replacement: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, showing all meekness unto all men.

edits.expected: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
edits.replacement: For we ourselves also were once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
edits.reason: Sometimes has the older formerly sense, not occasional foolishness still asserted as the time contrast; keeps ourselves in the admission and various prior clarification.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.expected: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;
edits.reason: The complete verse preserves earlier approved edits and the newly reviewed contextual clarifications.
edits.replacement: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Spirit;
poured out on us
edits.reason: The Spirit is poured out abundantly; shed is not disposing of an unwanted layer or physical blood here.

edits.expected: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.
edits.reason: The complete verse preserves earlier approved edits and the newly reviewed contextual clarifications.
edits.replacement: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be diligent to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.

evidence.label: Complete-verse KJV, NKJV, NIV, ESV and NRSVUE control

edits.expected: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;
edits.reason: The complete verse preserves earlier approved edits and the newly reviewed contextual clarifications.
edits.replacement: A divisive person after the first and second warning reject;
has turned from what is right
edits.reason: The divisive person has turned morally astray, not become the object of a political subversion; preserves sin and self-condemnation.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.replacement: being self-condemned
edits.reason: Of himself means self-condemned, not someone condemned about himself by an unspecified court. Preserve the preceding moral deviation and sin.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.replacement: to provide for essential needs
edits.reason: Explains practical needs to be provided for through good work; avoids the redundant necessary needs in my first draft while keeping the necessity of provision.
